findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12 There was no certified food protection manager present at the facility. PIC informed inspector that enrollment for CFPM classes and certifications are in progress. Ensure that there is at least one certified food protection manager present during operational hours at all times. 

(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.
